augments.name: Salvage Magnet
augments.desc: Pulls in loose debris after every fight: 20% more scrap.

augments.name: Plasma Cutters
augments.desc: Your crew strip and repair faster: repairs 20% quicker.

events.text: A cruise liner, adrift for years. The ballroom lights still flicker. The lifeboats are all gone.

success.text: Jewellery, credit chips and a very nice hat.

fail.text: The cabins are full of security drones that never got the message.

choices.text: Play one song on the ballroom piano.

effect.text: Your crew dance for a while. Nobody mentions the ghosts.

events.text: Half of a Fedoration warship, cut clean in two. The weapons bay looks intact.

fail.text: The bay is rigged to blow.

choices.text: Recover the dog tags of the crew.

effect.text: Fedoration command will want to know. Your crew are quiet for a while.

events.text: A scrapyard of dead drones, thousands of them, drifting in a slow spiral.

effect.text: Plenty of parts that still work.

fail.text: It wakes up angry, and so do its friends.

effect.text: {who} rebuilds one from four broken ones in an afternoon.

events.text: A salvage crew waves you off their claim. "Ours! Find your own wreck!" Their ship is barely holding together.

effect.text: Together you clear the wreck twice as fast. They share their best tool.
"It pulls in the good stuff. Mostly."
They fight harder than they look.

events.text: A bank shuttle, its vault door bent but closed. The emergency beacon is still asking for help.

fail.text: The vault's last defence is a burst of knockout gas.

effect.text: A trapped clerk climbs out of the vault, very grateful, and joins your crew.
